result.label: Source-read

claims.claim: The summons-content requirements apply unless another statute requires otherwise.
claims.quote: (a) Except as otherwise required by statute, a summons shall be directed to the defendant, signed by the clerk and issued under the seal of the court in which the action is pending, and it shall contain:

claims.claim: The summons must warn that if the defendant does not respond as directed, default will be entered upon the plaintiff's application.
claims.quote: (4) A notice that, unless the defendant so responds, their default will be entered upon application by the plaintiff,
claims.note: The draft preserves the application requirement.

claims.claim: The warning must say that the plaintiff may apply to the court for the relief demanded in the complaint.
claims.quote: and the plaintiff may apply to the court for the relief demanded in the complaint,

claims.claim: Possible consequences include wage garnishment, taking of money or property, or other relief.
claims.quote: which could result in garnishment of wages, taking of money or property, or other relief.
claims.note: These outcomes are possible, not automatic.

claims.claim: Section 412.20(a)(3) requires a direction to file a written pleading with the court in response to the complaint.
claims.quote: (3) A direction that the defendant file with the court a written pleading in response to the complaint within 30 days after summons is served on the defendant.

claims.claim: The deadline stated in that direction is 30 days after the summons is served on the defendant.
claims.quote: within 30 days after summons is served on the defendant.

claims.claim: Under §431.30(d), a verified complaint outside the specified Article 2 requires denial positively or according to the defendant's information and belief.
claims.quote: If the complaint is verified, unless the complaint is subject to Article 2 (commencing with Section 90) of Chapter 5.1 of Title 1 of Part 1, the denial of the allegations shall be made positively or according to the information and belief of the defendant.

claims.claim: For a verified complaint on a claim assigned to a third party for collection, that denial is required even if Article 2 applies.
claims.quote: However, if the cause of action is a claim assigned to a third party for collection and the complaint is verified, the denial of the allegations shall be made positively or according to the information and belief of the defendant, even if the complaint is subject to Article 2 (commencing with Section 90) of Chapter 5.1 of Title 1 of Part 1.

claims.claim: The cited summons is Judicial Council form SUM-100, revised July 1, 2009.
claims.quote: Judicial Council form SUM-100 (Summons), Rev. July 1, 2009

claims.claim: SUM-100 warns that failing to file a response on time may result in losing the case by default.
claims.quote: If you do not file your response on time, you may lose the case by default,

claims.claim: The form warns that wages, money and property may be taken without further warning from the court.
claims.quote:
and your wages, money, and property may
be taken without further warning from the court.

claims.claim: SUM-100 states a deadline of 30 calendar days after service.
claims.quote: You have 30 CALENDAR DAYS after this summons and legal papers are served on you
claims.note: The form identifies the documents served as the summons and legal papers.

claims.claim: Within that period, the form directs the defendant to file a written response at the court.
claims.quote: You have 30 CALENDAR DAYS after this summons and legal papers are served on you to file a written response at this court

claims.claim: The same deadline applies to having a copy served on the plaintiff.
claims.quote:
You have 30 CALENDAR DAYS after this summons and legal papers are served on you to file a written response at this court and have a copy
served on the plaintiff.

claims.claim: The form says a letter or phone call will not protect the defendant.
claims.quote: A letter or phone call will not protect you.

claims.claim: The form says there are other legal requirements.
The form says the defendant may want to call an attorney right away.
claims.quote: You may want to call an attorney right away.

result.summary: The supplied texts support each claim. The draft distinguishes entry of default upon application from possible collection consequences and preserves both conditions for the assigned-claim rule: verification and assignment to a third party for collection.
